_about: AIMEAT desktop default — every crew runs FULLY LOCAL on Ollama (no API keys, offline). The desktop drops this file into the crewaimeat working directory on first run (as llm_providers.json). gemma4 is the primary model: the AIMEAT crews REQUIRE tool/function calling, gemma4 supports it (verified via the Ollama OpenAI-compat endpoint), but gemma3 does NOT (it returns HTTP 400 'does not support tools'). So use gemma4 (or another tool-capable model) for agents — gemma3 is chat-only. To use a stronger cloud model for harder (e.g. coding) crews, add an OpenRouter/xAI provider AFTER the local one, or switch to the per-crew 'profiles' format — see llm_providers.example.json in the crewaimeat repo.
